discover.title: One platform for everything that makes a building smart.
discover.intro: Solea is a smart home ecosystem developed by FlowIT. It connects, controls and automates devices from different brands and technologies in villas, apartments, residential buildings and commercial properties.
discover.whatText: An app, a platform and, soon, a dedicated gateway. Together they replace the many manufacturer apps with a single, consistent and secure interface.
why: You are not locked into one brand: Solea is independent of manufacturers.
The whole installation is controlled from one place, on phone, tablet or computer.
Automations make devices that never knew each other work together.
Every compatibility is verified and documented, limitations included.

how.title: The devices
how.text: Lights, sensors, cameras, locks, air conditioners: over Zigbee, Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

how.title: The gateway
how.text: On site, it talks to the devices and runs automations as close as possible.

how.title: The platform
how.text: It securely synchronises the installation state, users and their rights.

how.title: The app
how.text: You see, control and schedule everything, at home or remotely.

discover.connectText: An installer or you add each device, place it in its room and give it a name. Zigbee sensors pair with the gateway; Wi-Fi and IP devices are recognised on the network; ONVIF cameras are discovered automatically when the model allows it.
discover.automateText: Choose a trigger (a time, a presence, a door opening), add conditions, then the actions to run in sequence. Scenes group several actions into a single tap.
discover.controlText: Dashboard, rooms, favourites, scenes, video, history: the same app for all devices and all household members, with rights suited to each person.
discover.evolveTitle: A solution that grows with you
discover.evolveText: Start with a few plugs and a sensor, add cameras, video intercom and access control later, then scale up to an entire residential building. The installation evolves without starting over.

privacyPage.title: Form privacy
privacyPage.intro: This page explains what happens to the information sent through the website forms. The full privacy policy will be published with the shop.
items: Controller: FlowIT, publisher of Solea. Contact: contact@solea-dz.com.
Data collected: only what you enter (name, email, phone, country, language, message).
Purpose: to answer your request, to notify you of the Solea Gateway launch if you asked for it, and to send you marketing information only if you agreed to it.
Retention: up to three years after our last exchange, then deletion.
Your rights: access, correction, deletion and withdrawal of consent at any time, by email to contact@solea-dz.com.
Cookies: the site only stores your language, country and currency preferences. No advertising cookies.
